humanTimeStatus: Transferred prediction, not measured Korean time
permission: Task text redistribution authorised by the project owner on 16 November 2026. Original source rights remain with their holders.
aggregation: Equal task weights within entry, then equal entry weights within occupation.
mapping: Existing route-A modal KSCO eighth-revision three-digit mapping, retained for reproducibility; unmapped rows are preserved.

employment.definition: Survey-weighted total employed persons, all recorded ages and education groups
employment.period: 2023–2025 average of six April and October waves
employment.aggregation: Sum mutually exclusive age-by-education cells within each occupation and wave; arithmetic mean of six wave totals
employment.source: Existing Regional Employment Survey derived occupation panel
employment.bubble_area: Proportional to employed persons; radius = 28 * sqrt(employment / maximum employment), in SVG units
employment.status: Observed survey-weighted estimates, not task-level employment or 2026 employment

interface.comparison: Top ten by absolute rank difference among 162 occupations; ties by horizon score
interface.map_x: Predicted human completion minutes, linear axis
interface.colour: Fixed dark-to-light scale from zero to maximum horizon score across retained scenarios

representative_labels.selection: Illustrative occupational categories spanning the exposure-duration space; not a statistical selection
representative_labels.layout: Measured text width; strict node and label collision exclusion; straight leaders; recomputed on zoom, pan and resize
representative_labels.font: 13.2 CSS pixels minimum, approximately 1.2 times the previous 11-pixel font
representative_labels.crowded_views: Unplaceable or off-screen labels are temporarily omitted
